access.authentication: No credential or Authorization header is used; public info request examples require only Content-Type: application/json.
access.payment: Public info endpoint; no payment or key flow used. Per-request credits/charges are not documented for this anonymous route.
access.runtime_readiness: RESPONDED_FOR_ETH_FUNDING_HISTORY_AND_CURRENT_PERP_SNAPSHOT; anonymous seven-day ETH fundingHistory returned 168 identity/window-matched hourly rows at 2026-10-17T16:52:36Z and is retained in a validated local replay run. No Authorization header/payment flow used; terms and redistribution rights remain unverified.
access.terms_review: No provider Terms page was successfully retrieved in this bounded review; no redistribution right is claimed. Official API docs specify inclusive millisecond start/end bounds but no maximum history window, so the client uses a conservative seven-day local maximum. Official historical-data docs say users may use the API to record additional historical datasets. A seven-day ETH response is retained locally for deterministic replay; this does not establish redistribution rights.

supported_routes.task: historical funding for one exact perpetual instrument
supported_routes.request: POST /info with type=fundingHistory, coin, startTime, endTime
supported_routes.source_priority: Supplemental venue-specific funding history; not cross-venue aggregate funding.
supported_routes.bounds: One coin and a maximum seven-day window per command; local output cap 200 rows; one request and no retries. Seven days is a conservative local bound, not a provider-documented maximum.
supported_routes.normalization: Preserve Unix-millisecond settlement timestamps and raw fundingRate; normalized funding_rate_decimal is per funding period, not annualized. Hyperliquid documentation describes hourly settlements. The endpoint docs specify inclusive millisecond start/end times but do not state a maximum historical window.
supported_routes.identity: Every returned row must exactly match requested coin and fall within requested inclusive time window.

supported_routes.task: current per-instrument perpetual context including open interest
supported_routes.bounds: One response, select one exact coin by matching metadata universe index to asset context index; one request and no retries.
supported_routes.normalization: Preserve provider numeric strings and numeric parses. OI USD denomination is unverified; the endpoint supplies no observation timestamp, so retrieval time is not market observation time.
supported_routes.identity: Requested coin must occur exactly once in the returned metadata universe.

rate_limits.official: 1200 aggregate REST weight/minute per IP; fundingHistory weight 20 plus additional weight per 20 returned items; other documented info calls weight 20.
rate_limits.local: One request per invocation, 10-second timeout, 1MB response ceiling, 30-second memory cache, no retries.

independence.rule: Distinct venue-origin observations from DeFiLlama aggregate data, but one venue is not market-wide funding or OI. Do not count multiple wrappers over Hyperliquid as independent.

known_gaps: No historical per-instrument open-interest endpoint was qualified; this route only returns a current OI context without an observation timestamp.
The returned OI unit is preserved but its USD denomination is not verified.
Only ETH funding and current perp context have live response evidence; other coin identifiers remain implementation-only.
Only ETH funding history has a retained seven-day replay artifact; other coin identifiers remain implementation-only. Redistribution rights remain unverified.
fallback: Do not substitute aggregate DeFiLlama OI for instrument-level OI or use Hyperliquid ETH history for another venue/instrument. Preserve unavailable and missing history explicitly.
